relevance.rationale: WRONG JOIN. The seeded id was schrodinger1950, whose registered entry is a single-author monograph. This PDF is a journal article by a different author on a different subject (quaternions and non-commutative geometry, reformulating the electroweak sector so gauge and Higgs fields are one generalized Yang-Mills field over a discrete structure); identity reported separately to the caller. The filename is a volume-issue-page string, which is presumably what the seeding matched on. No key covers it: references.ts registers two other works by this author, but not this one — it is a third paper in that series. id set to null. ON THE MERITS: the folio's quaternionic content (the tetraplectic / Reeb-triad material citing the two registered works by this author) concerns quaternionic structures on flag manifolds, not non-commutative-geometry gauge-Higgs unification, and the folio's Higgs sector is not built this way. I can name no block that would consume a result from it, so it does not rise above tangential; the honest disposition is to register the reference if the author wants that series complete, not to force a citation. SEPARATELY on the schrodinger1950 citation itself (einstein-nonsymmetric-metric-comparison.md:1 and .ts:32): it is a single historical-context mention alongside the non-symmetric field theory discussion — appropriate but not load-bearing, and now unverifiable since no copy of the book is present.
